dct_description_sm: The main objective of this project is to ensure that the impacts of climate change are incorporated in community decision-making and long-term planning. The project will focus on incorporating the communities of Wlinak and Odanak's climate change adaptation plans to their respective emergency plans. Specifically, the project will focus on the following objectives: (1) conduct a vulnerability assessment of community infrastructure; (2) develop an adaptive strategy to reduce risks of coastal erosion; (3) integrate extreme weather event considerations to emergency plans; and (4) develop climate hazard maps for both communities.
